evidence.note: Kenneth Roy Calkins obituary, published January 11, 2026, explicitly gives February 19, 1935 birth and December 31 death under 1935–2025 heading. Identity independently matches University of Chicago historian and the 1958 Cheyenne protest truck injury. Legacy person page explicitly indexes December 31, 2025. Retrieved complete obituary text via web tool; direct local download HTTP403. Existing portrait preserved.

September 1, 1958 National Guardian printed/PDF p4 original image and caption explicitly identify Mr. and Mrs. Kenneth Calkins and their August 18 custody for leafleting. September 22 p7 describes several hours held that day. Earliest arrest in this existing protest case; not used as the day of later sustained jail confinement.

September 22, 1958 National Guardian printed/PDF p7 expressly places both in Laramie County jail on August 29 and describes Kenneth transfer to jail after ten hospital days following August 19 truck injury. Establishes sustained confinement began within August 1958, but not a sufficiently verified exact admission day. Stored August 1 with month precision, displayed August 1958; no first-day claim or calculated release.
